page.layout: One column: a centred heading at the top, then a list of index lines, each a chapter title, with "FINIS." centred below the list.; One column of page numbers at the right, each with a line of contents text to its left. The left parts of the lines are cut off in this scan, except for a few fragments.
page.notes: The index lines are printed in black type. The blue marks running across and under the lines are ink annotations and are not transcribed. "talem." is the continuation of the line "De diuisione Relationis in Prædicamentalem" and is set as its own line. The second line of the list is printed with a shorter first word indent, which is typographic only. The line numbers 73 to 133 stand at the right, each beside its own line. The fragment "...am diuisionibus." (80) and "...m & Transcenden-" are italic. The "V M" at the top right may be the end of a running head and is given as printed. The line 124 sits under "Transcenden-" and may belong to the next line of that entry; the alignment of that row is uncertain.
